title: MosaicRV PMU counter measurement schema (I-076)
description: The PMU mapping: one entry per event counter, naming its width, its scope, whether it is architectural (reachable by a program through a CSR) and whether an ISA reference can reproduce it. A counter that is not CSR-visible must say so here rather than be presented as architectural evidence; CASE=pmu.trace_accounting reconciles every entry against a hand-computable trace and prints this same visibility classification.

profile.description: The profile this mapping was measured on.

event.description: The observation point: the event or state the counter advances on.

width_bits.description: The RTL port width. One aggregate may pack several counters (for example o_lane_elem_ctr packs eight 32-bit per-lane counts), so this is the packed width.

scope.description: What the counter is scoped to. per-hart and per-core mean one instance per hart/core; per-cluster and per-link mean one per cluster or per fabric link, summed by the reader when a core-wide number is wanted.

csr_visible.description: True only if a program can read this counter through a CSR. Debug-only counters are false.

csr.description: The CSR address, present exactly when csr_visible is true.

reference_comparable.description: True only if an independent ISA reference (a functional model or the architectural event trace) can reproduce this value. Implementation-only counters are false.

rtl_port.description: The RTL output that publishes the counter, or "none" for a value carried in the architectural event stream.

reconciled_by.description: The check in CASE=pmu.trace_accounting that ties this counter to the hand trace or to a conservation identity.

not_covered.description: Observation points the card names that this mapping does not carry, each with the reason.
